_meta.purpose: Curated drug-interaction lookup for the medication_interaction addon. The dataset originates every interaction claim; the LLM only phrases explanations. Demo-curated, textbook-level subset — verify against a real drug knowledge base before any production use.

ibuprofen+warfarin.effect: NSAIDs like ibuprofen can increase the anticoagulant effect of warfarin and irritate the stomach lining, raising the risk of serious bleeding.
ibuprofen+warfarin.guidance: Do not take ibuprofen while on warfarin without explicit direction from the prescribing clinician; prefer a pharmacist-approved alternative for pain.

aspirin+warfarin.effect: Combining two antithrombotic agents substantially increases the risk of bleeding, including gastrointestinal and intracranial bleeding.
aspirin+warfarin.guidance: Only use together under close medical supervision with INR monitoring.

clarithromycin+simvastatin.effect: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, sharply raising simvastatin levels and increasing the risk of muscle damage (myopathy, rhabdomyolysis).
clarithromycin+simvastatin.guidance: Ask the prescriber to pause simvastatin or switch antibiotics/statin for the course of treatment.

lisinopril+potassium.effect: ACE inhibitors reduce potassium excretion; supplements or salt substitutes high in potassium can push levels dangerously high (hyperkalemia).
lisinopril+potassium.guidance: Avoid potassium supplements and salt substitutes unless blood levels are being monitored.

fluoxetine+tramadol.effect: Both raise serotonergic tone; combined use can cause serotonin syndrome (agitation, tremor, fever, rapid heart rate) and lowers the seizure threshold.
fluoxetine+tramadol.guidance: Seek immediate medical advice if agitation, tremor, sweating, or fever occur; tell every prescriber you take both.

metformin+prednisone.effect: Corticosteroids can raise blood glucose and counteract metformin's effect, worsening glycemic control.
metformin+prednisone.guidance: Monitor blood glucose closely during steroid courses and inform the diabetes care team.

aliases._meta: brand/common name -> canonical generic name. Every value must be a drug that appears in an interaction key above; aliases pointing at unknown drugs are ignored at load time.
